messages.subject: Packrat and Production Data Files
parts:
I am interested in using packrat for projects that we publish to a Shiny server.  My only concern is that our projects contain data files (.rda) that should not overwrite those that already exist on the server.  Does packrat have a way to handle such situations so the server's data files won't get overwritten when the project is unbundled?  I would expect everything else to get overwritten.

Thanks,
Bryan

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Packrat and Production Data Files
parts:
Unfortunately no such mechanism currently exists. One thing we've considered is allowing for project-specific 'ignore' rules; e.g. allowing the user to specify a regular expression that will whitelist or blacklist files matched by that regular expression. You could imagine having something like:

    packrat::opts$bundle.ignore("data/.*[.]rda$")

but this hasn't yet been fully fleshed out or implemented yet.
